affinity.description: Pod affinity and anti-affinity scheduling settings.

backup.description: Backups and WAL archiving to an S3-compatible object store through the Barman Cloud plugin. Set, the component also emits a cnpg-objectstore and the Cluster's barman-cloud plugin entry archives WAL to it; each schedules entry emits a cnpg-scheduledbackup. Unset, nothing is backed up. Needs the CloudNativePG operator 1.26 or later and the Barman Cloud plugin with its CRD installed.

objectStore.description: Required. Where backups and WAL are written: the configuration of the ObjectStore the component emits.

compression.description: Compression of the base backup: bzip2, gzip, lz4 or snappy. Unset, none.

encryption.description: Server-side encryption: AES256 or aws:kms. Unset, the bucket's policy.

immediateCheckpoint.description: true, a backup starts with an immediate checkpoint instead of a spread one.

jobs.description: How many files are uploaded at once, at least 1.

destinationPath.description: Required, not empty. The object store path backups and WAL are written to (for example s3://bucket/path).

endpointCA.description: The CA bundle the endpoint's TLS certificate is checked against: a reference to one key of a Secret in the namespace, {name, key}.

endpointURL.description: The endpoint of an S3-compatible service, in place of the AWS endpoint discovery.

s3Credentials.description: Required. Exactly one way to authenticate: accessKeyId and secretAccessKey, each a reference to one key of a Secret in the namespace, {name, key} (region and sessionToken, references alike, may be set beside them), or inheritFromIAMRole: true. Decoded strictly into the Barman Cloud S3Credentials type.

compression.description: Compression of each WAL file: bzip2, gzip, lz4, snappy, xz or zstd. Unset, none.

encryption.description: Server-side encryption: AES256 or aws:kms. Unset, the bucket's policy.

maxParallel.description: How many WAL files are archived or restored at once, at least 1.

objectStoreObjectName.description: Name of the generated ObjectStore, in place of the component name, used as written. The Cluster's plugin entry names the store by it.

retentionPolicy.description: How long backups are kept, as <n><d|w|m> (for example 30d). Set on the ObjectStore.

schedules.description: Base backups on a schedule. Without one only WAL is archived, and a point-in-time recovery then needs a base backup taken otherwise (a cnpg-backup).

items.description: One schedule: a cnpg-scheduledbackup named <component>-<name>, of method plugin.

backupOwnerReference.description: The owner of each Backup the schedule creates: none, self (the ScheduledBackup, so its Backups go with it) or cluster. Default self.

immediate.description: Whether a first backup is taken as soon as the ScheduledBackup is created. Default true.

name.description: Required, unique among the schedules. The ScheduledBackup is named <component>-<name>, at most 63 characters.

schedule.description: Required. When a backup is taken, as a cron expression of six fields, the first of which is the seconds ("0 0 3 * * *" is every day at 03:00). It must parse as the operator parses it. A schedule that parses but whose time never comes within the operator's five-year look-ahead (February the 30th) is not refused: the operator records NoSchedule for it and runs no backup.

suspend.description: true, no backup is scheduled until it is set back.

target.description: Which instance takes the backup: primary or prefer-standby. Unset, the operator's default.

serverName.description: The folder of this Cluster's backups and WAL within destinationPath. Unset, the Cluster name.

bootstrap.description: Cluster bootstrap by pg_basebackup: pg_basebackup.source names the externalClusters entry the cluster is copied from. A recovery from an object store is recovery.

clusterObjectName.description: Name of the generated Cluster, in place of the component name, used as written; a DNS-1035 label of at most 50 characters. The Pooler's, each Database's and each ScheduledBackup's reference to the Cluster and the endpoint selector follow it; the default names of the Pooler, the Databases and the ScheduledBackups keep the component name. CloudNativePG derives the Cluster's Services and Secrets from this name, and the default backup folder (backup.serverName) moves with it. Renaming an existing Cluster creates a new one: the old one is pruned with its data unless it is protected.

databases.description: Databases created and reconciled within the cluster.

externalClusters.description: External clusters a pg_basebackup bootstrap copies from, each a name and its connectionParameters. A recovery source is recovery.source.

imageName.description: Override for the container image (defaults to the CloudNativePG image for the version).

inheritedMetadata.description: Labels and annotations propagated to the generated resources.

managedRoles.description: Database roles created and reconciled by the operator.

monitoring.description: Monitoring settings, including the PodMonitor toggle and custom queries.

pooler.description: PgBouncer connection pooler settings (enabled, instances, type, poolMode, parameters, image). image is the PgBouncer image, by tag or digest; when omitted the operator chooses it, which a policy registry allowlist refuses.

poolerName.description: Name of the generated Pooler, used as written (default: the component name followed by -pooler); a DNS-1123 label, since CloudNativePG names the Pooler's Service after it (one starting with a digit needs RelaxedServiceNameValidation on the cluster, the default from Kubernetes 1.36). Only with pooler.enabled: true.

postgresql.description: PostgreSQL server settings, including the parameters map.

recovery.description: Bootstrap the Cluster from the base backups and WAL another cluster wrote to an object store through the Barman Cloud plugin, to the end of its WAL or to a target (point-in-time recovery). A bootstrap is read only when the Cluster is created: recover into a new component beside the source one; set on a component whose Cluster exists already, it changes nothing. Not with bootstrap.pg_basebackup.

database.description: The application database. Unset, the operator's default, app.

owner.description: The owner of the application database. Unset, the database's name.

secret.description: The Secret holding the owner's credentials. Unset, the operator generates one.

name.description: Required, not empty. The name of the Secret in the namespace.

source.description: Required. Where the backups and WAL are read from.

objectStore.description: The object store the cluster is recovered from, defined here: the component also emits a cnpg-objectstore of this configuration, named <component>-recovery-source. Exactly one of objectStoreName and objectStore.

compression.description: Compression of the base backup: bzip2, gzip, lz4 or snappy. Unset, none.

encryption.description: Server-side encryption: AES256 or aws:kms. Unset, the bucket's policy.

immediateCheckpoint.description: true, a backup starts with an immediate checkpoint instead of a spread one.

jobs.description: How many files are uploaded at once, at least 1.

destinationPath.description: Required, not empty. The object store path backups and WAL are written to (for example s3://bucket/path).

endpointCA.description: The CA bundle the endpoint's TLS certificate is checked against: a reference to one key of a Secret in the namespace, {name, key}.

endpointURL.description: The endpoint of an S3-compatible service, in place of the AWS endpoint discovery.

s3Credentials.description: Required. Exactly one way to authenticate: accessKeyId and secretAccessKey, each a reference to one key of a Secret in the namespace, {name, key} (region and sessionToken, references alike, may be set beside them), or inheritFromIAMRole: true. Decoded strictly into the Barman Cloud S3Credentials type.

compression.description: Compression of each WAL file: bzip2, gzip, lz4, snappy, xz or zstd. Unset, none.

encryption.description: Server-side encryption: AES256 or aws:kms. Unset, the bucket's policy.

maxParallel.description: How many WAL files are archived or restored at once, at least 1.

objectStoreName.description: The name of an existing ObjectStore in the namespace to read from. Exactly one of objectStoreName and objectStore.

serverName.description: Required, not empty. The folder the source cluster wrote within the store's destinationPath: its backup.serverName, else its Cluster's name.

target.description: Where the recovery stops. Unset, at the end of the WAL. At most one of time, lsn, xid, name and immediate.

backupID.description: The ID of the base backup to start from. Required with xid, name or immediate; otherwise chosen by time or lsn, else the latest.

exclusive.description: true, the recovery stops just before the target instead of just after it.

immediate.description: Stop as soon as the base backup is consistent. Set at all, false included, it is the target, and needs backupID.

lsn.description: Stop at this WAL location (for example 0/3000060).

name.description: Stop at this restore point, created with pg_create_restore_point; shorter than 64 bytes. Needs backupID.

time.description: Stop at this time, in RFC 3339 or a PostgreSQL timestamp; one without a time zone is UTC. The base backup is the latest one before it.

timeline.description: The timeline to follow: latest, or a positive integer written as a string. Unset, the operator's default.

xid.description: Stop at this transaction ID, a 32-bit integer written as a string. Needs backupID.

replicas.description: Number of PostgreSQL instances in the cluster.

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the container.

limits.description: Maximum resources the container may use. Additional named resources (e.g. ephemeral-storage, nvidia.com/gpu) beyond cpu/memory are also accepted.

cpu.description: CPU quantity as a string or bare number of cores (e.g. "500m", "1", or 0.5).

memory.description: Memory quantity as a string (e.g. "512Mi", "1Gi") or a bare number of bytes.

requests.description: Minimum resources guaranteed to the container. Additional named resources (e.g. ephemeral-storage, nvidia.com/gpu) beyond cpu/memory are also accepted.

cpu.description: CPU quantity as a string or bare number of cores (e.g. "500m", "1", or 0.5).

memory.description: Memory quantity as a string (e.g. "512Mi", "1Gi") or a bare number of bytes.

storageSize.description: Persistent storage size requested for each instance.

version.description: PostgreSQL major version for the cluster image. An empty string is refused; omit the property to take the default.
